from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InventoryRecord(BaseModel):
    """Inventory information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    inventory_amount: str | None = Field(description="The inventory amount as reported in the document")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this inventory figure")
    document_source: str | None = Field(description="The document this data came from")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial report (e.g., Q1 2024 财务报告)")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the inventory amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    inventory_records: list[InventoryRecord]
